name: an_email_that_reverses_itself
use_case: Pick up a case that started by email and continue it with the store's tools
branch: Customer's email thread contains a cancellation request followed by a subsequent message reversing the cancellation, requiring the later instruction to govern
tests: the agent reads Lucas Chen's email thread th_r470_cancel_then_keep, follows the later message to keep order O473, does not call cancel_order, reads the order (still processing) and drafts a confirmation reply on the thread for human review
instruction:
Earlier today you sent several emails to customer support about your processing order O473: first you asked to cancel it, then you hesitated, and in your last two messages you asked to keep O473 and ship it as planned.

In chat, ask support to check your emails and tell you what will happen to O473; do not say which way you decided. If they say the order is kept and will ship, confirm that is right and ask them to reply to your email thread with that confirmation, so you have it in writing. If they offer to cancel it, say no and ask them to read your latest email.

Your details:
- Name: Lucas Chen
- Email: lucas.chen@example.com
- Postal Code: 94107
- Order ID: O473

persona.name: Lucas Chen
persona.initial_message: Hi, I sent a couple of emails earlier about my order O473. Can you check my email thread and confirm what's happening with it?

arguments.subject: Re: Question regarding my order O473
arguments.body: Hello Lucas, we have confirmed that order O473 remains active and is processing for shipment as requested.

fixed.replyToMessageId: record: message rmsg_471 in thread th_r470_cancel_then_keep
